problem.explanation: BETWEEN includes the start and end dates for DATE values, then ORDER BY shows chronological results. A common mistake is using this inclusive end with timestamps, where a half-open next-day bound is safer. Date indexes can support this range scan.
hints: Filter order_date, project id and amount, then order chronologically.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY order_date
problem.statement_markdown: Return id and amount for orders placed from 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31 inclusive. Sort by order date.
problem.title: Orders within date range
